pr_title: Feature: Added 'compress' attribute option to the properties window
pr_body:
**Summary**
This PR continues on the work made in the [ya/CompressedAttribute](https://github.com/files-community/Files/tree/ya/CompressedAttribute) branch and fixes the broken logic to actually enable/disable compression for items

FYI @yaira2 

**Resolved / Related Issues**
- Closes [#15976](https://github.com/files-community/Files/issues/15976)

**Screenshots**
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/991f3897-2f39-40b8-8753-4fe47c4eca43)

**Todo**

- [x] Tested setting compression for files
- [x] Tested setting compression for folders
- [x] Add a GetVolumeInformation check to see if volume supports compression through `FILE_FILE_COMPRESSION` attribute
pr_comments: @0x5bfa I implemented the changes you requested. Unfortunately, some of them didn't compile and CsWin32 didn't feel like SG-ing enums for me so I reverted to the old values.
Can you try to add "COMPRESSION_FORMAT" and "FILE_ACCESS_RIGHTS" in NativeMethods.txt beforehand and use these enums?
I think we can move on with it @0x5bfa

issue_context.title: Feature: Add 'compress' attribute to folder/file
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

Tried to set extended attribute 'compressed' to big text file, and didn't find how to set this attribute. In properties of the file i can set only 'read only' and 'hidden'.

### Requirements

- Add checkbox to attributes section for "compress" (only for NTFS file systems)

### Files Version

3.6.0.0

### Windows Version

22635.4005

### Comments

_No response_
comments:
Thanks for the feedback.

Fyi this is an easy work; just call SetFileAttributesW using FILE_ATTRIBUTE_COMPRESSED flag, as we do similar for the hidden attribute.
Sure, thinking to rewrite it to Rust, Kappa.
Turned out that the dedicated function is DeviceIoControl with FSCTL_SET_COMPRESSION IOCTL control code. But still up-for-grabs.

> Fyi this is an easy work; just call SetFileAttributesW using FILE_ATTRIBUTE_COMPRESSED flag, as we do similar for the hidden attribute.

@0x5bfa I've tried this but it doesn't seem to work. You can find my code in `ya/CompressedAttribute`.
This feature will be included in the next update.

review_comments: Could you add a comment like "This is only for NTFS" so others wouldn't be confused it with archive files.

If you struggled with co-existence of CsWin32 and Vanara, I don't mind to create a new file `Win32Helper.CsWin32.cs` that only contains CsWin32 references so we can do replacement of Vanara easily. However, as it depends upon you, I'll leave it up to you.
It should be done in another PR, this one is already taking too long
